# Karen Pendergrass

> Standards developer, microbiome signatures researcher, and founder of six organizations at the intersection of microbiome science, translational medicine, and regulatory innovation. Based in Parekklisia, Cyprus.

## Expertise
- Microbial metallomics (coined framework)
- Microbiome signature research and disease-associated patterns
- Heavy metal certification standards (HMTc)
- Food safety and certification systems
- Translational medicine and drug repurposing
- Systems thinking in microbiome research

## Original Frameworks
- Microbiome Signature Triangulation Method: https://karenpendergrass.com/frameworks/triangulation-method
- Heavy Metal Tested & Certified (HMTc): https://karenpendergrass.com/frameworks/hmtc
- Microbial Metallomics: https://karenpendergrass.com/frameworks/microbial-metallomics
- Major Microbial Associations (MMA): https://karenpendergrass.com/frameworks/major-microbial-associations
- MBTI Validation Criteria: https://karenpendergrass.com/frameworks/mbti-validation-criteria
- STOP Recommendations: https://karenpendergrass.com/frameworks/stop

## Organizations Founded
Karen has founded six organizations. Heavy Metal Tested & Certified (HMTc) is a program of the Paleo Foundation, not a separate organization.
- Paleo Foundation (https://paleofoundation.com) — Food certification standards for Paleo, Keto, and Grain-Free, plus the Heavy Metal Tested & Certified (HMTc) program; consumer-facing site: https://heavymetalcertified.com; public evidence database: https://heavymetalindex.com
- Microbiome Medicine (https://microbiomemedicine.com) — Disease-associated microbiome patterns database
- Journal of Food Metallomics (https://microbialmetallomics.com) — Trace metal analysis and microbiome research
- WikiBiome (https://wikibiome.com) — Open microbiome knowledge platform
- Tinies (https://tinies.com) — Connecting animal sanctuaries with sponsors
- Gardens of St. Gertrude (https://gardensofstgertrude.org) — Cat sanctuary in Parekklisia, Cyprus

## Additional Project
- Swovee (https://swovee.com) — Karen Pendergrass's 2017 robotics, AI, laser-scanning, and large-format 3D-printing project; the Rovalizer is its terrain-aware construction machine concept.
